properties.note: lowest-energy B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP malonic acid minimum in this study (syn conformer, intramolecular O1...H-O7 hydrogen bond, O1...O7 2.64 A); 27 real frequencies
six-membered cyclic decarboxylation TS (ring C5-C4-C2-O1...H11-O7); exactly one imaginary frequency -407.7 cm-1; IRC verified in both directions (ts/ts_0006/jobs/declaration_0001/irc/irc.log)
hydrogen-bonded complex of ethene-1,1-diol (acetic acid enol) with CO2, verified minimum (27 real frequencies); +17.4 kcal/mol above RC
acetic acid + CO2, verified minimum (27 real frequencies); overall reaction -4.6 kcal/mol

explored four-membered (C4-H11-O7-C5) direct-decarboxylation saddle, one imaginary frequency -372.2 cm-1; IRC failed to converge, so this strained branch is not competitive and has no IRC direction proof

notes.methodology: gas phase, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP (Gaussian 16), barriers are electronic energy differences without ZPE/thermal corrections against the lowest verified malonic acid minimum (RC, calc/rc_min/rc_min.log).
notes.unresolved: The second step of the enol route (keto-enol tautomerization of ethene-1,1-diol to acetic acid inside the CO2 complex) was not located: the GFN2-xTB path guess stalled twice, a constructed intramolecular 1,3-H-transfer guess descended back to the enediol (57 TS steps, no saddle), and a relaxed O1-H11 scan dissociated. The INT and P nodes are therefore connected only through the investigated direct channel in this graph; the tautomerization TS remains an open gap.
notes.thermochemistry: E(acetic acid + CO2) - E(malonic acid) = -4.6 kcal/mol (electronic).
